categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement processes, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
